attr.title: OpenAirStrike
attr.desc: Open-source engine for the helicopter shooters AirStrike 3D, AirStrike 2 and AirStrike II: Gulf Thunder. One or two players, online co-op.
attr.inst: Requires your own copy of AirStrike 3D, AirStrike 2 or Gulf Thunder (Windows). Copy the game folder, its zip or its installer into ports/openairstrike/gamefiles/.
